verification: Original single-linear-constraint paper arithmetic and independently reviewed source/reader explanation; no solver, engine or GPU execution.
limits: One fixed anchor and one 1kg particle, C=x−1m; no coupled cloth or contact
PBD k=.5 is per-iteration projection factor, not a universal compliance conversion
Compliance .01m/N, h=.1s, multiplier unit kg·m; reset once per solve, accumulate within iterations
Second h=.05s example fixes predicted position solely to compare the conditional update
Finite iterations can still produce artificial compliance; no same-trajectory or convergence-speed guarantee
No damping, warm-start implementation, engine integration or performance measurement
